title: Essex County dedicates soccer field in Riverfront Park for Albert Coutinho

Essex County dedicates soccer field in Riverfront Park for Albert Coutinho
Essex County dedicated the Albert "Al" Coutinho Soccer Field in Riverfront Park on Wednesday, Oct. 7, in honor of the late Ironbound community leader.
Essex County Executive Joseph N. DiVincenzo, Jr. dedicated the Albert "Al" Coutinho Soccer Field in Essex County Riverfront Park on Wednesday, Oct. 7, in honor of the late Albert "Al" Coutinho, according to Essex County. Coutinho was a businessman, co-founder of the Ironbound Soccer Club, organizer of the Newark Portugal Day Festival and a former New Jersey State Assemblyman. He died March 29, 2026, in a car accident, the county said.
"There were three things that Albert loved: his family, his hometown of Newark and the game of soccer," DiVincenzo said. "Naming the soccer field in Riverfront Park after him will keep his memory alive, keep his memory close to the game that he loved and hopefully inspire future generations to follow in his footsteps in giving back to their neighborhoods," he added.
Coutinho's niece, Emily Goncalves, said he "was an advocate for fields like the one we are naming in his honor today." Congressman Rob Menendez presented Coutinho's family with a flag that was raised over the Capitol Building in Washington, D.C. John Soares, co-founder of the Ironbound Soccer Club, said the most important thing to Coutinho was "the $3 million in college scholarships earned by his athletes."formerGovernor Phil Murphy said, "This is the only public event I have done since I left office and it is because there is only one Albert Coutinho."erson of Portuguese descent elected to the New Jersey Assembly, according to the plaque text provided by the county.
Coutinho's name was added to the scoreboard at the field off Raymond Boulevard in Newark, and a bronze plaque was installed at the field's entrance, the county said. Land for Essex County Riverfront Park was acquired in 2010, and the park opened in 2012, according to the county.
